scripts.clean:all: npm run clean -w web && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.firebase:deploy: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${ENV_DIR:?ENV_DIR must be set}; [ -f "$ENV_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" ] && . "$ENV_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" || true; set +a; : ${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:?FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm run build -w web && firebase deploy --project "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID"'
